digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup config/auth composition
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture deployment/startup config once at service initialization and compose fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot per operation/request
Request-scoped inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain transient context and never leak into startup bindings, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or child environments
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (gerrit_bot_token, GitHub, LLM credentials) before accepting a job/webhook, and route only the selected integration without principal fallback
Static startup bindings must remain unchanged across ambient file/environment mutation; new bindings are observed only after process restart/redeploy
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable observability without affecting the underlying operation result, while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed
Service constructors must accept optional runtime bindings to support gradual rollout before cutover, with a legacy facade available for rollback
